speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, can you describe the appearance and distribution of the rash on your palms, and how long ago did the numbness and tingling first begin?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your occupation, I suspect a parasitic infection; have you noticed any linear, thread-like burrows on your palms or between your fingers? I would also like to examine the web spaces of your fingers and the flexor surfaces of your wrists for signs of mite activity.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of your rash, eyebrow thinning, eyelash loss, and hypopigmented macules strongly suggests Hansen's disease. DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy
